body:
A 25-mile El Segundo climate and living atlas: NOAA normals,35years of rain and practical seasonal routines.

Independent PointCast research and design by Codex. The Object Library is a concept demo, with no inventory, bookings or hardware claimed. The atlas separates station observations, normals, regional trends and scenarios; its map polygons and suitability guidance are illustrative. Original Nouns-inspired SVG characters import no token art and imply no official affiliation.

[Open the feature](/weather-atlas/).
